summary: Align get_budget_snapshot pressure vocabulary with costs/what_next (critical not high) so budget gates fire on low remaining; fleet plan_fleet_from_intent + fleet_status hydrate remaining under base_dir/budget.
migration_impact: budget_pressure value 'high' is no longer emitted from get_budget_snapshot; consumers that only checked critical/exhausted now correctly treat low remaining as critical. Fleet status/plan with base_dir no longer read operator spend.json.
agent_notes: Treat budget_pressure as ok|elevated|critical|exhausted only. Prefer base_dir for fleet plan/status isolation in tests.
